brain.commentary: Cross-asset regime is risk-on, but aggregate conviction and composites are only marginally positive. Maintain a reduced risk budget. BTC is the strongest signal but still lacks meaningful alpha. ETH and SOL have weak edge with elevated beta/volatility, while LTC is explicitly flat and materially weaker. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile: identical verdicts and zero volatility/expected-shortfall inputs indicate likely missing or stale risk data, so their long signals should not receive full weight.
